correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the exact event after scale removal, proves the lower endpoint is outside the support, rewrites the remaining event using the exact Weibull survival function, and obtains an additive o(1) expansion of its exponent from Stirling. Because the exponent error is o(1), exponentiation legitimately yields a multiplicative probability equivalent. Uniformity on compact threshold intervals follows from the exponentially small mean-to-standard-deviation ratio and bounded log y.

value.rationale: The motivating anti-concentration function is identically zero and therefore discards all dependence on the standardized threshold. The renormalized theorem recovers a nonconstant limiting profile \(y^{-2/e}\) and an exact threshold-ratio law. This answers a natural structural question about what survives after the qualitative invariant collapses, rather than merely tightening a finite numerical bound.
